newsitem.title: USA: Continental in pact with Business Air.
newsitem.headline: Continental in pact with Business Air.

text.p: Continental Airlines said on Wednesday it has entered into a code-sharing agreement with Business Air, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Airlines of Britain Group (ABH), effective September 16.
Continental said it will place its designator code on Business Air flights between Manchester, England and Aberdeen, Dundee, Edinburgh, and Glasgow, Scotland.
ABH is also majority owner of British Midland Airways.

Continental said that passengers destined for Scotland will be able to book their ticket with Continental such that they take Continental's daily Flight 20 to Manchester, and then, under the ticketing arrangement, be transported by bus to connect to a Business Air flight to any of the cities in Scotland the agreement covers.
Or conversely, they could fly the same way back to Newark from Scotland.
The agreement is subject to approval by the U.S. Transportation Department, the airline said.
